headline: On October 27, 1994: Gliese 229B Identified as First Substellar Object
captionCards: This discovery expanded our view of star systems
instagramCaption:
Gliese 229B made astronomical history. \\[On October 27, 1994, astronomers identified Gliese 229B as the first unquestionable substellar mass object. Located 18.8 light-years away in the constellation Lepus, it is part of a system with a red dwarf and two brown dwarfs. The primary star has 58% of the Sun's mass and rotates very slowly at just 1 km/s. This discovery expanded our understanding of stellar and planetary formation.\\Why do you think this discovery was so significant? Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
